gloss: blushing; turning red in the face

definitions.gloss: blushing; turning red with embarrassment or shame
definitions.explanation: The face turning red due to embarrassment, shame, or awkwardness. Can describe both the physical reaction and the feeling of embarrassment itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{褒|ほ}められて→褒める：01204_homeru⟧{赤面|せきめん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I blushed when I was praised.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失言|しつげん}→失言：12189_shitsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づいて{赤面|せきめん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I turned red when I realized my slip of the tongue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{赤面|せきめん}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{告白|こくはく}した→告白する：19631_kokuhakusuru⟧。
examples.english: He confessed his feelings while blushing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{赤面|せきめん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Whenever I recall past mistakes, I still blush.

notes:
Describes the physical act of blushing due to embarrassment or shame. The word combines {赤|せき} (red) and ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (face). More literary and formal than the everyday expression ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤面|せきめん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to blush
- {赤面|せきめん}もの: something embarrassing (enough to make one blush)
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{赤面|せきめん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to blush involuntarily

REGISTER:
More literary and formal than colloquial expressions. In everyday speech, ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ or ⟦{恥|は}ずかしくて→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ are more natural.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn red in the face — everyday expression
- ⟦{照|て}れる→照れる：08152_tereru⟧: to feel embarrassed, to be shy — focuses on the emotion rather than the physical reaction
- ⟦{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}→顔面蒼白：24203_ganmensouhaku⟧: turning pale — the opposite physical reaction, caused by shock or fear
